metadata.quantiles: median: midpoint of middle pair; p95: nearest rank ceil(0.95*n), withheld below n=100
metadata.interleaving: round-robin, case order rotated left by sample index; warmups in manifest order

caches.node: disabled except two explicitly prepopulated cases
caches.deno: owned DENO_DIR; transpile dependencies prewarmed, V8 code cache disabled
caches.bun: owned runtime transpiler cache; only sufficiently large files use it
caches.clearing: prepare recreates marked tmp/startup-baseline and its owned external consumers; each run clears own node-cache before untimed prepopulation
caches.filesystem: warm/unspecified OS filesystem cache; fresh processes are not cold filesystem cache

metadata.commandTokens: REPO_ROOT=checkout; CONSUMERS_ROOT=owned external directory from consumer-root.json; *_BIN=mise which runtime; *_DIR=dirname of that binary
